query: What realistic model-size, latency and compute budgets enable real-time on-device ellipse fitting and pupil estimation for sensors with 3–5 μm pixels on common embedded hardware?

response.query: What realistic model-size, latency and compute budgets enable real-time on-device ellipse fitting and pupil estimation for sensors with 3–5 μm pixels on common embedded hardware?
response.answer: Real-time on-device ellipse fitting and pupil estimation on common embedded hardware with 3–5 μm pixels is feasible using lightweight models with low latency and compute budgets, such as MobileNet or SqueezeNet. These models achieve real-time processing with minimal computational overhead.
